summary: Live activity chronicle with on-demand redaction attestation and incremental delivery proof
description:
Issue summary: Customer requests a near-real-time, tenant-scoped audit feed with per-event redaction exceptions and a signed attestation package for regulators. Impact: NordPay needs evidence for a regulator (EU payments authority) that (a) events containing payment metadata are redacted according to their policy, (b) exceptions (merchant-allowed fields) are auditable and cryptographically verifiable, and (c) the incremental delivery preserves ordering and resume tokens for backfill. They require a one-off signed sample bundle and a path to continuous incremental delivery with manifest proofs.

Requested deliverable: (1) A signed incremental feed (HMAC per-batch and per-event checksum) for tenant nordpay-prod, covering a 24h window with annotated redaction decisions; (2) an on-demand attestation file (signed manifest + signed sample payloads) that binds exporter version, KEK id, and manifest signature; (3) guidance doc for their security team and a short scheduled runbook for replays/backfills.

Why unique: They have strict regulator timelines and need evidence that redaction exceptions are applied deterministically and that the delivery is tamper-evident.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer activated tenant-scoped audit export in Console -> Exports -> Create export (type: incremental, format: JSONL, delivery: S3 signed-manifest)
2) Customer configured a redaction-exceptions list for merchant IDs via the policy UI (policy id: rp-anchored-2026-01)
3) Customer triggered an on-demand export for 2026-03-08 00:00 - 2026-03-08 23:59 UTC
4) Customer attempted to validate manifest signatures and per-event HMACs using their shared secret and observed missing "redaction_exceptions" annotation on a subset of payment events
5) Customer opened ticket when exported bundle did not include the expected attestation metadata (KEK id + exporter git sha + redaction_decision_reason)
logs: sample exporter log snippet: [2026-03-08T14:02:17Z] exporter=exporter-3 instance=ae-prod-4 tenant=nordpay-prod event_id=evt_01A2 msg=writing-batch batch_id=batch-20260308-1402 manifest_ref=manifest-8b6f status=ok; [2026-03-08T14:02:18Z] exporter=exporter-3 tenant=nordpay-prod event_id=evt_01A2 msg=redaction-decision missing_annotation=redaction_exceptions; [2026-03-08T14:02:19Z] signer=manifest-signer msg=sign-manifest fail=KEK-lookup-timeout;
comments: 2026-03-10 09:12 - Customer (Helene, NordPay): 'We need a signed sample for our regulator by EOD. The current export is missing the per-event redaction reason field and the manifest does not include the KEK id used to sign.'

2026-03-10 09:35 - Support (Maya Chen): 'Thanks Helene — confirming intake. We're escalating to SRE and the audit-exporter team. Can you attach the failing manifest and one sample event JSON that shows the missing field?'
2026-03-10 10:02 - Customer (Helene, NordPay): 'Attached manifest (manifest-8b6f.json) and sample event (evt_01A2.json). We also reproduced HMAC mismatch when validating with shared secret.'

2026-03-10 11:20 - Eng (Diego Alvarez): 'Initial triage: exporter wrote batch but signer logged KEK-lookup-timeout. Hypothesis: KEK rotation during the window caused manifest to be unsigned or signed with unavailable key. Investigating key-service and signer latency around 14:02Z.'

2026-03-11 15:01 - SRE (Priya K.): 'We saw transient 503s from keystore-service from 14:01:58Z to 14:03:05Z in eu-west. Batch requeue logic did not surface an explicit error; signer returned null kek_id and sent unsigned manifest. We're reproducing locally using same exporter version.'

2026-03-11 16:45 - Eng (Diego Alvarez): 'Working on a hotfix to ensure exporter delays commit until manifest signature completes and to include redaction_decision metadata as an explicit per-event envelope field. Will prepare signed sample once patch is verified.'
2026-03-12 08:22 - Customer (Helene): 'Appreciate the update. Regulator has requested the signed sample and the procedural description of how exceptions are approved.'
investigation_notes: Checked exporter version: audit-exporter v2.7.1 (git sha: a4f3c9e). The version that wrote manifest-8b6f lacks explicit redaction_decision inclusion when an exceptions list is used via UI. We traced code path to redact service v1 that returns decisions to exporter but not all decisions were serialized into event envelope.

Observed keystore-service incident (incident id: KSS-20260308-14) with several 503s in eu-west window. manifest-signer fallback path returns empty kek_id when keystore lookup times out. No retry throttling configured on signer RPC path in this release.

HMAC mismatches reproduced: customer used old shared-secret (rotated on 2026-03-01). Confirmed mismatch when using previous secret. Valid HMAC computed with rotated-secret matches exported batches that were properly signed.

Ordering/resume tokens: exporter wrote resume_token to batch metadata for all batches in the window; however manifest-8b6f lacked the signature and kek_id. S3 objects exist and are retrievable; only the manifest signature is missing for some batches.

Related change: PR #2218 in audit-exporter added a non-blocking manifest write path (merged 2026-03-01) — this allowed writes to succeed even when manifest signing failed. Suspect interaction between that PR and keystore transient errors.

Reproduction steps in staging: toggling KEK access penalty simulates keystore timeouts and reproduces missing kek_id behavior. Patch verified in staging to block commit until manifest signature or explicit signed-manifest retry completes (max 3 attempts).
resolution_notes: Temporary workaround provided on 2026-03-11: support re-triggered an on-demand export after temporarily enabling 'commit-block-on-sign-failure' flag for nordpay-prod and re-running manifest signer with a pinned KEK. Delivered a signed sample bundle (nordpay-sample-20260308-signed.zip) to customer SFTP. Planned permanent fix: deploy audit-exporter v2.7.2 with blocking manifest-sign path and explicit per-event redaction_decision serialization. Scheduled rollout: canary 2026-03-13 -> gradual 2026-03-14, with monitoring alert (alert id: AUDIT-SIGNATURE-FAIL) and keystore-service retry backoff adjustments. Follow-up actions: provide NordPay a short runbook describing replay and attestation validation, and issue a postmortem for KSS-20260308-14.
notes_for_customer: Delivered signed sample to NordPay SFTP on 2026-03-11 18:07 UTC. We will schedule a 30-minute review call (engineering + security) to walk through the manifest contents and verification steps. Please confirm receipt and whether the regulator accepts the artifact format; we can convert to alternate formats on request.
next_steps: 1) Complete v2.7.2 rollout with blocking manifest-sign path and per-event redaction_decision field (owner: Diego Alvarez)
2) Add defensive retries on signer/keystore path and increase observable metrics for signer latency (owner: SRE)
3) Produce formal attestation template and sample validation script for NordPay security team (owner: Support)
4) Run postmortem for KSS-20260308-14 and identify process for KEK rotation verification during exports (owner: Security)
5) Close ticket after customer confirms regulator acceptance and signed-manifest delivery verification
